## VariableResourceClient.list() method

List variables, as one page holding all of them. When several workflows share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the workflow.

**Signature:**

```typescript
list(workflowName: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Page<Variable>>;
```
